a.lede: The protesters stormed over the walls and took over the construction site, with the Stop Dirty Data Centers coalition saying that more actions are planned across Europe.
a.title: Protesters storm Microsoft AI data center construction site

b.lede: As data center protests break out across Europe, a mismatched band of campaigners is trying to block Google from building a sprawling new facility east of London.
b.title: Bikers and Bug-Lovers Join Forces to Fight a New Google Data Center
